aliases: 2 MP Fixed Bullet WiFi Network Camera

storage.notes: microSD up to 128GB + NAS (NFS, SMB/CIFS) with ANR; Hik-Connect cloud.

features: 2.4 GHz WiFi (802.11b/g/n, up to 150 Mbps, ~80m range) + RJ45 fallback
built-in microphone (mono) with environment noise filtering
microSD up to 128GB + NAS/ANR, Hik-Connect cloud
Digital WDR, 3D DNR, BLC/HLC, H.265+ compression
fixed 2.8mm or 4mm lens, metal front cover, IP66
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CV1021G0-IDW1 is a 2MP fixed-bullet WiFi camera (2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n, RJ45 fallback) with 30m IR, a built-in microphone, and a microSD slot up to 128GB. Consumer/value line — no ONVIF; Hik-Connect / RTSP for integration.

frigate.notes: Hikvision native RTSP (main 101 / sub 102) — enable RTSP in the Hik-Connect app / web UI. WiFi 2.4GHz only; a wired substream is steadier for detect.

home_assistant.notes: No ONVIF on this consumer WiFi model — use the Generic Camera integration with the RTSP URL, or Hik-Connect.

blue_iris.notes: Select the 'Hikvision' profile; add via RTSP.
